title: Being drafted in 1940 with Morand and Horace Malcolm
summary: Williams registered in the first draft with Herb Morand, Horace Malcolm and Tom Taylor but did not serve because he had six dependent children.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yeah. 41, the war broke out. In the 40s. In the 40s. I was registered in the 40s. First draft in the 120. Me, Moran, and Horace Malcolm. You were drafted?
Oh, yeah. Yeah. But I didn't go because I had dependent children.

Six children at that time. Yeah. I was in the first draft of the United States. Yeah. Horace Malcolm, me, Moran, we were all around the same. Moran didn't go for it. Moran was a great big guy, this big, he's too big, you know, too big. That time they wasn't taking big men.
Who else was with you? Tom Taylor and...
Tom Taylor, me, Tom Taylor and Moran.
No, Alcon wasn't on that one.
Maybe he was, some job he was with you. Yeah. Because they told me about it.
